# ADR-3001: A01: Object-level authorization check for resource family 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Missing object-level checks allow horizontal privilege escalation.

## Decision

Services SHALL NOT return or mutate objects without an object-level authorization check for resource family 1 (A01-1).

## Consequences

Denied requests remain observable in access logs.
